I rent this small plot here in the North East, so I must be careful with my money. The soil is tired and rains can be uncertain, so I will put a little urea and NPK if the price at the market is not too high, and I also carry manure from my goats to help the soil. I buy improved maize seed from the agrodealer because it yields better than the old seed I save, but I cannot afford to irrigate — I depend on the rains. My children and I will do most of the weeding, and I will hire a few young men for land preparation and the second weeding when the grass is heavy.
